elements.quote: Four previous reviews have assessed the quality of COVID-19 CPGs [16-18]. Two of them focused on the CPGs produced in the early phase of the pandemic... However, an assessment of all the CPGs focused on the management of critically ill COVID -19 patients was lacking.

elements.quote: Given the extraordinary burden that the pandemic has created on the emergency and critical care units worldwide, there is an urgent need for evidence-based guidance to facilitate optimal clinical and policy decisionmaking. We, therefore, aimed to systematically identify the CPGs for the management of critically ill patients with COVID-19, and critically assess their quality...
elements.reason: The text explicitly explains the importance and need for the review due to the pandemic's burden and the urgent need for evidence-based guidance.

elements.quote: However, this study is not free of limitations. We had to exclude, for now, CPGs that were written in languages that were not covered by our research team (i.e., Japanese). Moreover, the assessments were conducted only on CPGs that were either published in peer review journals or posted in official websites as CPG full documents, without considering unpublished or supplementary material, therefore, it is possible that some information was missing to inform the quality of the CPGs in this iteration but it is planned to be covered in the following series of this living review.
